dct_description_sm: The primary project goals related to this data set are:  i) creating local sea ice dictionaries ii) exploring knowledge representation iii) undertaking curriculum development.   The data documents Inuit knowledge of sea ice (e.g. floe edge position, tidal cracks, polynyas, travel routes, dangerous areas, changing ice conditions, safety indicators, and Inuktitut terminology) for the purpose of developing educational materials that can be used by a variety of audiences.  Additional local sea ice monitoring and group work will contribute to determining effective strategies for including such information in school curriculum, educational materials, sea ice safety awareness, and assessments of environmental change impacts and adaptation.
